title: Sidebar collapse does not survive reload — `sidebar_state` cookie is written but never read back (`SidebarProvider` always starts from `defaultOpen = true`)
body:
## Symptom

Collapsing the console sidebar does not survive a page reload.

- The cookie **is** written: `sidebar_state=false`, 7-day max-age — and it is **still present after the reload**.
- Yet the sidebar renders **expanded**: width **255px**, `data-state=expanded`.
- Measured at **+2s / +4s / +8s** after load specifically to exclude a settling race — expanded at every sample.
- **Reproduced 3×.**
- Expected: with `sidebar_state=false` present, the sidebar renders collapsed on first paint.

## Root cause

`packages/components/src/ui/sidebar.tsx` only ever **writes** the cookie and never reads it back.

- `SIDEBAR_COOKIE_NAME = "sidebar_state"`, `SIDEBAR_COOKIE_MAX_AGE = 60 * 60 * 24 * 7` (~lines 36-37) — matching the observed 7-day max-age.
- `setOpen` writes it on every toggle: `document.cookie = ...` (~line 101). That is the **only** occurrence of the cookie name in the whole package.
- `SidebarProvider` initialises from the prop default: `defaultOpen = true` → `const [_open, _setOpen] = React.useState(defaultOpen)`. There is no cookie read, no lazy initialiser, no hydration effect.
- **No SPA caller passes a cookie-derived `defaultOpen`.** The only `defaultOpen={false}` call sites on main are marketing/demo components in `apps/site`; the console shell passes nothing, so it gets `true` every load.

The upstream shadcn original resolves this by reading the cookie in a **server component** and handing the value down as `defaultOpen`. A pure SPA has no equivalent of that step — **so the fix needs an SPA-side read** (a lazy `useState` initialiser or equivalent that parses `document.cookie` on mount), not merely "pass the prop". Passing a prop from the console shell alone still leaves every other SPA consumer broken.

Verified still present on objectui **`origin/main` @ `bb68488`** (current at filing time), not just on the vendored console `09987b68` the run used.

### Honest contrast — the rest of `shell-nav-personalization` is healthy

This is a narrow defect, not a broken persistence layer:

- **Pins, favorites and recents all persist correctly**, backed by real `sys_user_preference` rows.
- **Reorder is blocked** — not failing, *untestable*: **no drag affordance is rendered at all**.
- **Recents capture record visits but not object-list visits.**

## Reproduction

Framework `a86db175`, vendored console `09987b68`, showcase app, authenticated session.

1. Collapse the sidebar.
2. Confirm the cookie: `sidebar_state=false`, max-age 7 days.
3. Reload the page.
4. Confirm the cookie is **still** `sidebar_state=false`.
5. Measure the sidebar at +2s, +4s and +8s after load.

Observed: 255px and `data-state=expanded` at all three sample points. Reproduced 3×.

## Dedup

Searched objectstack-ai/objectui for `sidebar_state`, `SidebarProvider`, `defaultOpen`, and sidebar-collapse-not-persisted symptoms — no open or closed duplicate found.

## Source

Extracted from the QA run objectstack-ai/objectstack#7514 (framework a86db175, vendored console 09987b68). Root-cause re-verification is against objectui `origin/main` @ `bb68488`.
